svg.title: Mean course of daily GPP from 14 days before to 14 days after the start of the fertilisation episodes, in percent of the mean of the 14 days before, for episodes with fertilisation only and with tillage or sowing.
svg.desc: Two lines with a band of plus or minus one SD. X axis: day relative to the first day of the episode (-14 to +14, local days). Y axis: daily GPP in percent of the mean of days -14 to -1. Fertilisation only: 4 episodes; mean of days +10 to +14 228 % (mean of the daily SDs 214 %). With tillage or sowing: 7 episodes; mean of days +10 to +14 138 % (mean of the daily SDs 239 %). Days with fewer than 2 episodes are not shown. Episodes with a mean GPP before of less than 0.5 g C m-2 d-1 are not used. The spread between the episodes is large.
